summary: Implemented all 5 phases of the release-engineering-and-PyPI-rehearsal plan. Fixed the `cd Code` -> `cd code` casing bug in `.github/workflows/release.yml` (3 occurrences) plus the CHANGELOG link path. Migrated publishing to PyPI Trusted Publishing (OIDC): removed the long-lived PYPI_API_TOKEN, restructured the workflow into a `build` job (python -m build, twine check --strict, upload-artifact) feeding `publish-testpypi` (continue-on-error: true) and `publish-pypi` (both environment-gated, id-token: write, pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1), plus a `github-release` job. Rewrote `.github/RELEASE_SETUP.md` to describe the single real workflow and the OIDC setup (trusted publishers + GitHub Environments), removing references to the two nonexistent workflow files. Ran a NixOS-safe local rehearsal (isolated venv created inside `nix develop`, `flake.nix` untouched): python -m build, check-wheel-contents (clean), twine check --strict (PASSED on wheel and sdist), and a parity diff against the last published model-checker==1.2.12 (confirmed model_checker-1.3.0 naming, no oracle path, and classified all observed deltas as intended). Wrote a user-gated PUBLISH-CHECKLIST.md ending in explicit USER-ONLY push/tag/publish steps. No PyPI/TestPyPI upload, git push, tag push, or PR/merge was performed by the agent, per pr-prohibition.md.
